objective: Parse wbcan fault commands strictly and snapshot each selected fault configuration atomically.
acceptance: the entire command and mode-specific arity are validated
rejected writes do not change the armed configuration
standard and 29-bit extended identifiers are distinct and untruncated
any matching uses no valid CAN identifier sentinel
fault and bit-flip parameters are selected under one lock
concurrent writes cannot mix two configurations
evidence: strict ABI and concurrent runtime assertions
stop_conditions: the numeric fault mode ABI would need renumbering
firmware or interface changes are required
a production control API is required
